title: Synergistic polyherbal formulation comprising Withania somnifera, Bacopa monnieri and Centella asiatica for neuroprotection
text: The present invention discloses a synergistic polyherbal composition comprising standardized extracts of Withania somnifera (Ashwagandha), Bacopa monnieri (Brahmi), and Centella asiatica (Gotu Kola) in specific proportions, exhibiting potent neuroprotective and memory-enhancing activities by mitigating beta-amyloid peptide aggregation and oxidative neuronal stress.
